from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
task_file = programs / 'task-a18cae23.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Complete a missing uniform band by wrapping the final band to the top.
    if all(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        if h > 1 and out[0][0] == 0 and out[-1][0] != 0:
            out[0] = out[-1][:]
        return out

    # Colored down-right diagonals encode one color for each residue class
    # of (column - row); repeat those classes across the full grid.
    diagonal_colors = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                d = c - r
                if d in diagonal_colors and diagonal_colors[d] != color:
                    raise ValueError("a diagonal contains multiple colors")
                diagonal_colors[d] = color
    period = len(diagonal_colors)
    by_residue = {}
    for d, color in diagonal_colors.items():
        residue = d % period
        if residue in by_residue and by_residue[residue] != color:
            raise ValueError("diagonal offsets do not define a consistent period")
        by_residue[residue] = color
    return [[by_residue[(c - r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
